# ui::TransitionStoryboard

Header: `winui/ui/Animation.hpp`.

The storyboard a theme or navigation transition builds for one element: key-framed tracks over its [TransitionTargetState](transition-target-state.md), started [`delay`](#delay) late (a stagger), scaling about [`scale_origin`](#scale_origin). When it ends the transition target goes back to identity.

Example: 
```cpp
// A custom "nudge": slide 12 DIPs right and back over 200 ms.
auto                     element = std::make_unique<ui::RectangleControl>();
ui::TransitionStoryboard nudge;
nudge.tracks.push_back({ui::TransitionChannel::TranslateX,
                        {ui::KeyFrame::linear(0ms, 0.0f), ui::KeyFrame::linear(100ms, 12.0f),
                         ui::KeyFrame::linear(200ms, 0.0f)}});
element->run_transition(std::move(nudge), [] { /* back at rest */ });

// Or one of the stock ones:
element->run_transition(ui::transition_storyboards::popup_in(ui::Point{0.0f, 40.0f}));
```

## tracks

```cpp
std::vector<TransitionTrack> tracks {}
```

The key-framed tracks.

## delay

```cpp
Duration delay {}
```

Start delay (a stagger).

## scale_origin

```cpp
Point scale_origin {0.5f, 0.5f}
```

Scale origin as a fraction of the size.

## duration

```cpp
Duration duration() const
```

Total length: the delay plus the longest track.

## empty

```cpp
bool empty() const
```

True when there is nothing to play (no tracks), e.g. for [NoPageTransition](navigation-transitions.md#struct-nopagetransition).
